entry.p: Speed limit information is displayed on the instrument cluster.

li.p: If speed limit information of the road cannot be recognized, '---' sign will be displayed. Please refer to Intelligent Speed Limit Assist malfunction and limitations if the road signs are difficult to recognize.

Intelligent Speed Limit Assist provides additional road sign information in addition to speed limit. When the additional road sign information is not available, it will be displayed as a blank on the cluster.
